text: Thank you for coming in. You mentioned fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and abnormal blood findings; to help me understand your condition, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if they are worsening?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text:
